branch_rules.both_pass: Record two successful local observable-production gates and retain their products as a one-system methodological resource. The global public-data ceiling supersedes H2 authorization to assemble H3 and X4 authorization to construct X5; do not run either downstream stage.
branch_rules.H2_fail: Record the exact immutable image and band failures; do not assemble H3, alter masks or models, or rerun thresholds.
branch_rules.X4_fail: Record the exact response, energy-grid, coverage, marker, or task-log failures; do not construct X5, substitute response products, or rerun thresholds.
branch_rules.any_branch: RX J2129 does not change the ten-system hard shortfall, no population dynamical/Weyl response is identifiable, and no latent-response or force-law fit is authorized.

supersession.principle: A passed component gate can authorize its local next interface, but a later independent global sample-identifiability ceiling can prohibit spending that authorization.
supersession.global_result: both local authorizations are terminally withheld because even an RX J2129 success leaves a nine-system strict-readiness deficit
